title: rewrite-ask-to-inbox-check-loop
description:
**Context:** The ask command was reworked in PRD to use an inbox-check loop (no flock) so it can coexist with a running watch. Current implementation calls self.poll() which acquires the flock — making ask incompatible with watch. Reply matching compares UUID field against name string (never matches), and poll auto-marks ALL messages read (violates read-marking principle).

**Goal:** Rewrite ask() to use inbox-check loop with UUID-based matching, marking only the matched reply as read.

**Steps:**
1. In skills/agent-comm/scripts/ac, rewrite the ask() method (line 570-628)
2. Keep the target resolution and online/offline check (lines 580-599) — correct as-is
3. Replace the poll loop (lines 609-627) with inbox-check loop:
   - Use self._poll_req(f"/api/agents/{aid}/inbox?unread=true&limit=50", timeout=30) — NOT poll()
   - Do NOT acquire flock
   - Sleep between checks (5s default)
4. Fix reply matching (line 622): compare msg.get("from_agent") == target_id (UUID) not == to (name)
5. Fix read-marking: after finding match, call self.mark_read(msg["id"]) for ONLY the matched message
6. Add SIGTERM handler: clean exit with exit code 1

**Constraints:**
- Ask MUST NOT use poll() or flock
- Ask MUST NOT mark any message read except the matched reply
- Ask MUST use UUID for reply matching, not agent name
- target_id already holds resolved UUID from _resolve(to) at line 583
- Sleep between inbox checks: 5 seconds

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] ask uses GET /api/agents/:id/inbox?unread=true&limit=50 (NOT poll endpoint)
- [ ] ask does NOT acquire flock — can run alongside watch
- [ ] Reply matching compares from_agent (UUID) against target_id (UUID)
- [ ] Only the matched reply is marked read — all other messages stay unread
- [ ] SIGTERM handler exits cleanly with code 1
- [ ] Timeout prints "No reply received (timeout)" to stderr, exit 1
- [ ] Target offline prints exact PRD error to stderr, exit 1
close_reason: Completed: ask() rewritten to inbox-check loop (no flock, coexists with watch), UUID-based reply matching, only matched reply marked read, SIGTERM handler

title: wire-rate-limiting-to-rest-endpoints
description:
**Context:** RateLimiter class exists in src/domain/rate-limit.ts with token bucket (burst 10, 1/sec). Never applied to any REST endpoint.

**Goal:** Wire RateLimiter to the 7 endpoint groups specified in PRD.

**Steps:**
1. In src/context.ts, ensure RateLimiter is instantiated and passed to REST transport
2. In src/transport/rest.ts, add rate limiting to these endpoints:
   - POST /api/messages
   - POST /api/messages/broadcast
   - POST /api/channels
   - POST /api/channels/:name/join
   - POST /api/state/:ns/:key
   - DELETE /api/state/:ns/:key
   - POST /api/state/:ns/:key/cas
3. Extract agent_id from request, call rateLimiter.consume(agentId)
4. If rate limited: return 429 with { error: "...", code: "RATE_LIMITED" }
5. NOT rate-limited: heartbeat, inbox, poll, read, feed query, agent CRUD, channel list, search

**Constraints:**
- New agents start with full bucket (10 tokens)
- Burst: 10, refill: 1/sec
- Error: { error: "...", code: "RATE_LIMITED" } with HTTP 429
- Per-agent by UUID

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All 7 endpoint groups return 429 when rate limited
- [ ] Read-only endpoints NOT rate limited
- [ ] Error response matches PRD format
- [ ] New agents start with full bucket
close_reason: Completed: RateLimiter wired to all 7 PRD-specified endpoints (messages, broadcast, channels, channel join, state set/delete/cas). 429 response via existing CommError handler.

title: fix-watch-startup-guard-and-max-unread
description:
**Context:** Watch startup guard should refuse to start if unread count exceeds threshold (default 50, configurable via --max-unread). Currently shows first 20 + warning at >20 and always starts. Missing --max-unread argparse flag. last_seen_id save uses max(all) instead of max(displayed).

**Goal:** Add --max-unread flag, refuse startup when exceeded, fix display thresholds and last_seen_id save.

**Steps:**
1. Add --max-unread argument to watch subparser in main() (near line 819):
   wa.add_argument("--max-unread", type=int, default=50, help="Max unread before refusing start (default 50)")
2. Pass max_unread to watch(): c.watch(args.interval, args.max_unread)
3. Update watch() signature to accept max_unread parameter
4. Rewrite startup guard logic (lines 489-511):
   - If len(new_msgs) > max_unread: print exact error and exit 1:
     Error: too many unread messages (N). Clear your inbox first: ac read-all or ac inbox
   - If 11-max_unread: print header "[WATCH] N unread messages (showing all)" + show all
   - If 1-10: show all (silent)
   - If 0: silent
5. Fix last_seen_id: set to max(m.get("id", 0) for m in displayed_msgs) — only displayed, NOT full list

**Constraints:**
- Error message must be EXACTLY: "Error: too many unread messages (N). Clear your inbox first: ac read-all or ac inbox"
- Exit code 1 on guard refusal
- Default --max-unread is 50 (not 20)
- State file save uses atomic rename (tmp+rename) — already implemented

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] ac watch --max-unread 10 refuses start if >10 unread
- [ ] Default --max-unread is 50
- [ ] Exact error message matches PRD spec
- [ ] Exit code 1 on guard refusal
- [ ] Display thresholds: 0=silent, 1-10=all, 11-50=all with header
- [ ] last_seen_id = max displayed message ID (not max of all unread)
close_reason: Completed: added --max-unread flag (default 50), startup guard refuses with exact PRD error msg at threshold, last_seen_id now uses max(displayed) not max(all)

**Constraints:**

- _heartbeat() already handles errors (lines 226-237)
- PRD: watch heartbeats on every inbox fetch cycle

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Watch sends heartbeat before entering main loop
- [ ] Watch sends heartbeat every cycle (every --interval seconds)

title: add-resetonstartup-and-reactivateall
description:
**Context:** PRD specifies two server startup behaviors: resetOnStartup() marks agents with heartbeat > 2min old as offline; reactivateAll() when OFFLINE_TIMEOUT=0 reactivates all offline agents.

**Goal:** Implement both startup behaviors.

**Steps:**
1. In src/domain/agents.ts, ensure resetOnStartup() exists: query agents where heartbeat > 2min old, set offline
2. Ensure reactivateAll() exists: query all offline agents, set online
3. In src/context.ts, after services wired:
   agentService.resetOnStartup()
   if OFFLINE_TIMEOUT=0: agentService.reactivateAll()

**Constraints:**
- resetOnStartup uses 2-min threshold (not OFFLINE_TIMEOUT)
- reactivateAll only when OFFLINE_TIMEOUT=0
- Never affect human agent

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] On start, agents with heartbeat > 2min marked offline
- [ ] OFFLINE_TIMEOUT=0 reactivates all offline agents
- [ ] Human agent never affected
close_reason: Completed: Added resetOnStartup() (2min threshold, skips human) called in constructor before reactivateAll. reactivateAll already existed.
